column1: # Ash Jenna's final test in Lamakan Desert. Names enemy row 92 (message 747).

column3: Before you follow me,\nI want to see what you\nare made of.{end_wait}
You're serious. Fine.\nIf this is what it takes,\nwe'll give you a fight.{end_wait}
Good. You didn't hold\nback, and neither did I.\nNow I know you'll last.{end_wait}
